course.title: Applied Statistics and Queuing Theory
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: A computer is shared by 2 users who send tasks to a computer remotely and work independently. (17) At any minute, any connected user may disconnect with probability 0.5, and any disconnected user may connect with a new task with probability 0.2. Let X be the number of concurrent users at time t, which is a Markov chain with 3 states: 0, 1, and 2.

i. Compute state transition probabilities and draw the transition diagram of the Markov chain.   
ii.Determine the steady-state distribution of the chain.
